svg.title: Published planned assembly rates · Berlin, Dresden, Rostock
svg.desc: City points coloured by listed occurrences per 100000 residents, 30 October–5 November 2026. Berlin 3.636, Dresden 2.655, Rostock 1.461. Other areas are unmeasured. Rostock uses a research-tool text extract. Public copy: machine-specific metadata removed. The recorded paths are published separately in provenance.json.
svg.text: A week of published assembly listings
30 Oct–5 Nov 2026 inclusive · Europe/Berlin · listed occurrences per 100,000 residents
3 listed starts in a tool text extract
These rates describe publication, not attendance.
Constant-size points; colour is a linear 0–4 rate scale.
Amber halo: Rostock text extract. Other places are unmeasured.
Country outlines: Natural Earth 1:50m · City points: GeoNames, WGS84 · Equirectangular display, standard parallel 52°N
Numeric denominator: Destatis official population, Census 2022 basis. Selected published listings only; no routes or spatial interpolation.
